content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Niche specialty prescription drug brand owner selling via specialty distributors, with ex-US partners handling sales abroad, like Puma."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a generic and injectable drug manufacturer with broad portfolios, not a single branded specialty drug franchise."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Generic injectables, inhalers and diagnostic kits made in plants and sold to hospitals and wholesalers, unlike Puma's branded oral cancer drug."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Industrial specialty chemical ingredients sold business to business to formulators, with no branded prescription drugs."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Branded specialty therapies for a narrow disease area, sold through specialty distributors and pharmacies, with global partners; similar model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Medical devices and biologics for orthopedics and pain, sold to surgeons and clinics rather than a prescription cancer drug."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Generic formulation developer and contract manufacturer earning development fees and royalties, not a branded drug owner."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Infusion devices and disposable consumables sold to hospitals, a device-led business unlike Puma's oral branded drug."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Niche branded prescription drug company for one therapy area, selling through wholesalers and clinics across regions; similar model."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Mainly holds royalty interests in respiratory drugs and sells hospital antibiotics and a critical care drug, not one oncology franchise."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Surgical devices, implants and instruments sold to hospitals and surgeons, not a prescription drug business."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Owns drug rights for a niche prescription drug and earns royalties from partners selling it abroad, closely matching Puma's licensing model."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Diagnostic imaging agents and radioisotope generators for hospitals and imaging centers, not therapeutic drugs sold to oncology providers."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Disposable medical devices for minimally invasive procedures sold to hospitals, not branded prescription drugs."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Regenerative tissue and skin substitute products for wound care, a biologic tissue business rather than a drug franchise."},{"label":"C16","good":true,"reason":"Branded specialty injectable drug franchise in a niche area with international licensing partners, though sold mainly to hospitals and surgical centers."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Pneumatic compression devices for lymphedema used at home, a device business unlike Puma's oral cancer drug."},{"label":"C18","good":false,"reason":"Broad portfolio of hospital medical devices sold through direct teams and distributors, not branded prescription drugs."},{"label":"C19","good":false,"reason":"Spine implants and bone graft products sold to spine surgeons, a surgical device and tissue business."}]}
